name: pah_muscle_lower9_malenfant2015
title: PAH, 9 lower muscle proteins (Malenfant 2015; team rat pipeline input)
description: The nine downregulated proteins of Malenfant 2015 Table 2 exactly as the team's rat protein pipeline uses them (paper symbols ATP5L / ATP5B mapped through UniProt).

name: pah_muscle_malenfant2015
title: PAH, skeletal muscle proteome (Malenfant 2015)
description: 19 iTRAQ proteins plus 6 phenotype genes from vastus lateralis of IPAH patients vs controls.

name: pah_blood_cheadle2012_eds
title: PAH, blood erythroid signature (Cheadle 2012)
description: 22 erythroid development genes reported up in PAH peripheral blood (GSE33463).

name: pah_blood_gse33463_ranked
title: PAH, blood PBMC full ranking (GSE33463; team pipeline)
description: Genome-wide IPAH-minus-healthy PBMC limma ranking (30 IPAH vs 41 healthy, GSE33463) produced by the team pipeline (MoTrPAC Hackathon/scripts 06-07); exercises the rank-association and pathway-concordance sections.

name: hostrup2022_hiit_proteome
title: HIIT training, muscle proteome (Hostrup 2022)
description: Vastus lateralis proteins changed after 5 weeks of HIIT; should agree with MoTrPAC training.

name: random_matched
title: Random abundance-matched genes
description: 25 random genes matched on expression decile to the PAH muscle signature; should score near the null.

name: random_mito9
title: Random MitoCarta genes marked down
description: 9 random mitochondrial genes all set to -1, showing what the pathway class alone scores.

name: tca_intermediates_demo
title: TCA intermediates (synthetic metabolite demo)
description: Synthetic RefMet metabolite list that exercises the metabolomics path; not a published signature.

name: type2_diabetes_muscle_mootha2003
title: Type 2 diabetes, skeletal muscle (Mootha 2003)
description: MSigDB MOOTHA_VOXPHOS, the OXPHOS gene set coordinately down in T2D/IGT vastus lateralis; down-only.

name: heart_failure_lv_hannenhalli2006
title: Heart failure, left ventricle (Hannenhalli 2006)
description: Genes up and down in failing vs non-failing human left ventricle (GSE5406), Enrichr crowd GEO signature.

name: aging_muscle_liu2013
title: Aging, skeletal muscle (Liu 2013)
description: Genes up and down in old vs young human biceps brachii (GDS4858/GSE38718), Enrichr crowd GEO signature.

name: septic_shock_blood_cvijanovich2008
title: Septic shock, whole blood (Cvijanovich 2008)
description: Genes up and down in pediatric septic shock vs control whole blood (GSE9692), Enrichr crowd GEO signature.
